collection.title: Citroen Relay Van - Split Rear Door 1994 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Relay/Jumper 1994 to 2005 model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
